report.candidate_letter:
Dear candidate,

Thank you for your application for the Python BackEnd Developer position. We will not move forward with your application, because your CV does not show the following required points: experience in asynchronous programming and performance-critical applications, and experience with machine learning. Additionally, there is no mention of algorithm development such as collaborative filtering or data normalization.

This decision was prepared with an automated system. You have the right to request a human review of this decision (GDPR Art. 22): simply reply to this message.

Kind regards
